<a id="type.McpStdio"></a>

### McpStdio (struct)

An MCP server started as a child process.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `string` |  | The program to run.<br><br>Rules: At least 1 character. |
| `args` | `list<string>`, optional |  |  |
| `env` | `map<string,string>`, optional |  | Extra environment variables.<br><br>Rules: Each key: matches `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$`. |

Example:

```json
{
  "command": "npx",
  "args": [
    "-y",
    "@acme/mcp"
  ]
}
```

<a id="type.McpHttp"></a>

### McpHttp (struct)

An MCP server reached over HTTP.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` |  | Rules: A URL; starts with `https://`.<br><br>Example: `"https://mcp.example.com/sse"`. |
| `timeout_ms` | `u32` | `30000` (30 seconds) | Unit: milliseconds.<br><br>Rules: Between `1` (1 millisecond) and `600000` (10 minutes). |

<a id="type.Contact"></a>

### Contact (struct)

A person in the address book.

Contacts are matched by `id`; names are free text.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  | Rules: A UUID. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Rules: 1 to 200 characters. |
| `emails` | `list<string>` |  | Rules: At most 10 items; no duplicate items; each item: an email address, at most 254 characters. |
| `score` | `f64`, optional |  | Rules: Between `0.0` and `1.0`. |
| `avatar` | `bytes`, optional |  | Rules: At most 65536 bytes. |
| `tags` | `map<string,list<string>>`, optional |  | Tag groups.<br><br>Rules: At most 16 entries. |
| `created` | `timestamp` |  | Rules: In the past. |
| `phone` | `string`, optional |  | Rules: An E.164 phone number.<br><br>Since 1.2. |
| `extra` | `json`, optional |  | Free-form metadata from the importer.<br><br>Example: `{"source":"vcard","rev":3}`. |

<a id="key.session.steer.enabled"></a>

#### `session.steer.enabled`

- Type: `bool`
- Default: `false`

#### `session.backend`

- Type: [`Backend`](#type.Backend)

- Level: basic

<a id="key.session.timeout"></a>

#### `session.timeout`

Turn timeout.

- Type: `duration`
- Default: `"600s"` (10 minutes)
- Rules: Between `"1s"` (1 second) and `"86400s"` (1 day).

#### `session.temperature`

- Type: `f64`
- Default: `0.7`
- Rules: Between `0.0` and `2.0`.

- Default: `50`
